## Root cause (confirmed from the task logs on our server)

This is not one strange message: **every** `--tool claude` solve of a hive-mind issue on 2026-10-10 ended this way (4 of 4, hive-mind 2.34.0, Docker isolation, 2.9 GB task memory limit). In each run Claude had **already finished successfully**, and solve then reported it as failed:

1. Claude emits its `result` event (success, e.g. `num_turns: 158`, cost captured): `📌 Result event received, starting 30s stream close timeout (Issue #1280)`.
2. The Claude CLI process does not exit within 30 s: `⚠️ Stream timeout — sending SIGTERM for graceful shutdown (Issue #1280, #1510, #1516)`, then `⚠️ Stream exited via force-kill timeout`.
3. The SIGTERM exit code is taken as the run's result: `❌ Claude command failed with exit code 143`, and `⚠️ 1 process(es) still running in /tmp/gh-issue-solver-… after the session ended: claude --output-format stream-json …`.
4. Solve then posts **"Solution Draft Failed"** with the failure reason set to Claude's own final success text (`CLAUDE execution failed with I fixed the four /queue problems … and marked PR … ready for review`), which is the "strange message that looks like the last message from AI".
5. It converts the PR back to draft (`📝 Converting PR: To draft mode`, then `PR #… stays a draft: it was already a draft before this run`), undoing the agent's own "ready for review", and exits 1.

The host was busy each time (5-min load 4–11 on 6 cores, the container at its memory peak `peak 2.9 GB` of the 2.9 GB limit), which is why the CLI needed more than 30 s to exit. The work itself was complete and pushed each time.

| Run (execution) | Issue | PR | Failure comment | PR now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `d48b9d75` | #2823 | #2824 | https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2824#issuecomment-6091706145 | ready |
| `bb570c11` | #2845 | #2853 | https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2853#issuecomment-6093372104 | still draft |
| `d2c72d4c` | #2889 | #2894 | https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2894#issuecomment-6094599215 | still draft |
| `324c89be` | #2917 | #2918 | https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2918#issuecomment-6095679290 | still draft |

## Suggested fix

- Once a `result` event with `subtype: success` (and `is_error: false`) has been received, the run's outcome is that result. A non-zero exit caused by our own close-timeout SIGTERM/SIGKILL (143/137) must not turn it into a failure. Log it as a warning (`CLI did not exit within 30s after a success result; terminated`).
- Never use the agent's final result text as a failure reason; when the exit is a failure, say why (`terminated by stream close timeout`, `exit code N`).
- Do not convert a PR to draft when the agent itself marked it ready during a successful session.
- Make the close timeout adaptive or longer under load (e.g. 30 s plus a grace while the CLI is still writing its session files), and log what the CLI was doing when it was killed.
- Add a test: a fake Claude that prints a success `result` and then sleeps 60 s must end as success, keep the PR ready, and post no failure comment.

Workaround until then: mark the PRs above ready for review by hand.
